result:
Fixed in `anthrouter/pace.py`. `period_workday_dates` treated `period_end` as inclusive. It is the first instant of the next month, so for UTC it counted Oct 1, 2026 (a Thursday) as a September workday. The end date is now taken from `period_end - 1µs`, which gives 22 workdays for September 2026.

The 53 pace and workday tests pass. I didn't run the full suite to completion. It was still running in the background after two minutes.

I did not add a new test for the UTC September case, since you asked for source changes only.
